page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a marginal note at the left beside the fifth and sixth lines. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: nes illis invitis sub fœdus suum trahere: quod
compertum fuerit eorum aliquem in Gronin-
genses aut horum socios aliquid deliquisse,
de eo ad arbitrium quatuor virorum, duo-
rum e Senatu Groningano duorum ex ipsis
datorum satisfaciat. Nec multos post dies
Snecani, Slotenses, Ilstani; cæterque
horum socii factionis Sciringiæ, fœderis
hostes, insigni clade ad Barrahusium à
fœderatis correpti, cum Boccone Ha-
ringæo, factionis principe, ad arbitrium
victorum conditiones acceperê. Iurarunt,
fœderi Ostergoo non se semet opposituros, nec
impedimento iis futuros, si qui deinceps aut
Ostergoi aut Westergoi accedere eidem vel-
lent: nullum jus imperiumve in universam
Ostergoam, aut ullam ejus partem sibi ar-
rogaturos, ablata reddituros, exules in in-
tegrum restituturos, controversa cum Gala-
mæis arbitrio Groningensium submissuros:
Groningenses in persequendis injuriis contra
Westergoos hac pactione non comprehensos
non impediturosː ē sociis in has leges peccan-
ti nemini patrocinaturos detrimenta impen-
dia, molestias belli Groninganis & Oster-
gois XVII millibus aureorum Rhenensium&

page.notes: Marginal note at left, "Pacta cum Scirin-giis", printed in two lines and transcribed as one note. Several words in the text are uncertain against the scan, notably "ringæo", the form of "Ostergoo" at the start of the fifth line of the paragraph, and the reading "Galamæis". The line "fœderi ... oppositurosnec" is joined in the image; I have separated it as "opposituros, nec". Ampersands at the line ends (Rhenensium&) are printed as shown. The word "XVII" is printed with spacing as "XV I I"; transcribed as XVII.
